literal_meaning: বড় (elder) + ঠাকুর (deity or elder brother/husband in family context)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার বড়ঠাকুর এখনো আমাদের খুব স্নেহ করে।
বড়ঠাকুরের বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে সবাই উপস্থিত ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: My elder brother-in-law still treats us with great affection.
Everyone was present at the elder brother-in-law's wedding ceremony.
note: This is a traditional kinship term in Bengali families, often used in rural or semi-urban contexts to denote respect for the husband's elder brother.
